## Information
When it comes to decorating your home or office this festive season, why not decorate with this traditional style festive foil decoration. Perfect for adding a seasonal finish to your home, school or office. This versatile foil garland can be hung all over the home, from the ceiling to the wall, doors or even in front of your window. The foil-coloured decoration will reflect light beautifully adding a touch of sparkle to your indoor area. This two tone garland in gold and ivory will suit any festive colour scheme and will make an enjoyable decoration for all to enjoy. The garland features 6 alternating sections and measures approximately 2.7M in length and 20cm in width once arranged. A simple, affordable traditional decoration add to your festive decor collection this year!
